cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
import sys,json
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace');sys.path.insert(0,'/tmp')
from wire import *
from harness import run
streamf=stream(0,0,b'abc',fin=True)
ack=b'\x02'+v(5)+v(0)+v(0)+v(5)
nci=b'\x18'+v(1)+v(0)+b'\x02xy'+b'z'*16
ret=b'\x19'+v(0)
close=b'\x1d'+v(9)+v(2)+b'ok'
body=streamf+ack+nci+ret+close+b'\x1f'
w=envelope('A',0,body,cid=b'\xbb')
r=run(trace([{'keys':['A']},datagram(w,(0,))],local_cids=('aa','bb'),cids=10))['traces'][0]
print(r['packets'],r['closed'])
print('opened/used',r['opened'],r['used'])
print('stream',r['streams'])
print('ack',r['acknowledged'][2])
print('peer',r['peer_cids'],r['retire_prior_to'])
print('retired',r['retired_local'],'received',r['received'],r['epochs'])
print('datagram',r['datagrams'])
